Draw a round of random segments for ground-truth annotation

Source: R/05b_groundtruth_sample.R
pam_recall_draw.Rd

Samples segments uniformly at random from the recordings, adds them to <paths$validation>/ground_truth/recall_segments.csv, and never draws the same segment twice. The ground truth belongs to the audio, not to a detection run, so it can be reused to compare runs (for example filtered against unfiltered audio).

Usage

pam_recall_draw(cfg, n = cfg$recall$n_segments, run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object (uses the recall section).

n

Segments to draw in this round.

run_id

Detection run. Only recordings that run processed are sampled, because recall is measured against that run. NULL samples all recordings.

Value

Invisibly, the newly added rows.
